The '''I2-CG droid''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] storage/transceiving [[Droid/Legends|droid]] carried aboard [[Tech 4 PDV]]. They were based on the [[ED4]] droid model from [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]].<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> When intercepted, Plexus Droid Vessels could jettison their I2-CG droids before self-destructing, covering the droid's escape.<ref name="Goratak">{{WEGCite|story=The Crystal Forest of Goratak|book=Star Wars Miniatures Battles (first edition)|reprint=1}}</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a Plexus Droid Vessel carrying information on [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] manufacturing on [[Tar Morden]] was intercepted. It self-destructed to avoid capture, but ejected the I2-CG which landed on [[Goratak III]]. An Alliance force, led by the ex-[[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Grindol Maal]] battled an Imperial force led by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Feskitt Bobb]] to retrieve the droid.<ref name="Goratak" />
